concerns.text: The plan computes Pearson (or Spearman) correlations between years_of_training and each edge within musicians but does **not** specify any multiple‑comparison correction across the ~19 500 edges. Without correction the reported r‑values and p‑values will be inflated, jeopardizing the validity of the secondary research question.

The sensitivity analysis sweeps significance thresholds (p = 0.01, 0.05, 0.10) but it is unclear whether these thresholds are applied to raw p‑values or to FDR‑corrected q‑values. Ambiguity here can lead to inconsistent interpretation of “significant” edges.

Cohen’s q is reported as an effect‑size for the correlation analysis, yet Cohen’s q is defined for comparing **two** correlation coefficients. Using it for a single correlation lacks a theoretical basis and may mislead readers.
